issues.description: Method parameter name mismatch for GroverLightsOutPuzzle.state_preparation: the template repository declares the parameter as 'switch_register' (template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py, def state_preparation signature), while the solution repository uses 'flip_register' for the same parameter (solution_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py, def state_preparation signature). The problem statement and the exercise text also refer to this register as the 'flip' register. In the template the docstring documents 'flip_register' even though the signature uses 'switch_register', which creates a naming inconsistency that can confuse students implementing or calling the method (they will see 'switch_register' in the signature but 'flip_register' in descriptions and other exercises).
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier across artifacts to avoid student confusion. Rename the parameter 'switch_register' to 'flip_register' in the template method signature (ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py state_preparation) and update any internal parameter references and docstring to consistently use 'flip_register'. Ensure any other template function signatures, docstrings, and example calls use the same name so the template, solution, and problem statement align.
